meta.note: Only indicators with audited:true have records. Others are listed so the gap is visible.

records.name: Literacy rate, youth total (% of people ages 15–24)
records.definition: Share of people aged 15–24 who can read and write, with understanding, a short simple statement about everyday life. Usually self-reported or household-reported through censuses and surveys.

records.name: Literacy rate, youth female (% of females ages 15–24)
records.definition: As youth literacy, for females aged 15–24.

records.name: Literacy rate, youth male (% of males ages 15–24)
records.definition: As youth literacy, for males aged 15–24.

records.name: Literacy rate, youth (ages 15–24), gender parity index (GPI)
records.definition: Female youth literacy rate relative to the male rate, as published by the source. A value above 1 means the female rate is proportionally higher.

records.name: Literacy rate, adult total (% of people ages 15 and above)
records.definition: Share of people aged 15 and above who can read and write, with understanding, a short simple statement about everyday life.

records.name: Foundational learning skills — reading (children 7–14)
records.definition: UNICEF Foundational Learning Skills module: reading accuracy, literal and inferential comprehension, where survey reports are public. Audit not yet started.

records.name: Publicly released national reading / literacy assessment results
records.definition: Results published by ministries of education (e.g. primary-level literacy tests). Audit not yet started.

records.name: Publicly released CSEC English A examination results
records.definition: Examination performance. A proxy indicator: it measures examination outcomes, not literacy directly. Audit not yet started.
